# Contentful

Contentful is a headless CMS allowing developers to create, manage, and distribute content across multiple channels and devices with an API-first approach

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/contentful/.

## Actions

- **Get space** (read-only): Retrieves details of a specific space by its id.
- **List spaces** (read-only): Lists all spaces that the authenticated user has access to in contentful.
- **Update space**: Updates the name of a specific space.
